entities.name: Circle
entities.description: Secret society of songmages led by Samor the Collector.

entities.name: Samor the Collector
entities.description: Songmage leader of the Circle, killed by Porros before finishing his song.

entities.name: Porros the Raptor
entities.description: Traitor in the Circle who killed Samor.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Claimed dominion over Almaaz and charged Samor with crafting a song to control the Beast.

entities.name: Beast of the Hours
entities.description: Cockatrice terrorizing the countryside around Sarraza.

entities.name: Almaaz
entities.description: Country Mishra claimed during the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Cheyne
entities.description: Young archaeologist, adopted son of Javin, seeking the truth of his birth parents.

entities.name: Javin
entities.description: Archaeologist and last Circle member, Cheyne's adoptive father.

entities.name: Ogwater Rifkin
entities.description: Down-on-his-luck songmage who guides Cheyne and banishes the Beast.

entities.name: Claria
entities.description: Descendant of the Collector who sold a map.

entities.name: Riolla Hifrata
entities.description: Crime boss working for the Raptor.

events.summary: Mishra summons the Circle to remove the Beast; a traitor sabotages the ritual so it is only trapped beneath the mountain.
events.quote: they can only trap it beneath the mountain

events.summary: Porros the Raptor kills Samor before he finishes the releasing song.
events.quote: kills Samor before he can finish writing all the instructions

events.summary: Cheyne befriends Ogwater Rifkin in Sumifa, who agrees to guide him to the Chimes.
events.quote: he befriends a down-on-his-luck songmage named Ogwater Rifkin

events.summary: Ogwater is forced to free the Beast of the Hours but banishes it with his song magic.
events.quote: Ogwater is forced to free the Beast of the Hours

relations.quote: who is working for the Raptor
